notes: Agentd read-only context planning is source-composed.
Global effect execution is not a production product callsite.
Exact records, request identity, retrieval policy, ranker policy, body generation, complete plan receipt and a monotonic process lease are bound before final use.
Typed append, raw append and reopen share one transition validator.
The public owner wrapper holds an operating-system-backed lock across open, backup and restore; uncertain mutation errors poison the current handle until drop and reopen.
A poisoned handle rejects authoritative checkpoint verification and dispatch-state inspection; its retained in-memory records are diagnostic only.
Generic append rejects execution-reserved dispatch-claim, terminal and reconciliation records; only the crate-local typed execution state machine can write their canonical envelopes.

Recovery projection first requires an exact durable claim, then validates ordered initial-terminal and reconciliation transitions; receipt-before-claim, grant drift, duplicate initial terminals and conclusive replacement fail closed.
Compaction preserves all non-snapshot semantic evidence and its preceding snapshot; independent anchor ownership and selected-target-host recovery remain external gates.
Repository source includes child-process lock-owner termination, abort-after-sync reopen and restore-under-live-owner regressions; these are source cases, not target-host pass receipts.
A stable request/grant dispatch claim is persisted before final authority revalidation and executor invocation; v1 claim envelopes remain readable.
Conclusive receipts are returned unchanged, unresolved claims reconcile by stable operation identity with the original grant, and public reconciliation requires an existing durable claim.
PlannerStore terminal sinks verify the canonical receipt digest, exact durable claim and original grant, and reject replacement of a conclusive terminal result.
Reopen reconstructs the same claim-to-observation state machine rather than trusting structurally valid execution records in isolation.
Authority failure after claim persists an explicit not-dispatched terminal receipt instead of leaving a false unknown-effect state.

A bounded DENY_ALL pending-dispatch page exposes unresolved claims in round-robin claim-sequence order without granting redispatch; the product recovery controller and exact request resolver remain external composition work.
Trusted in-process read-only handlers are not a sandbox.
A canonical fanout evidence digest binds the exact generation, source, output port, payload digest, ordered admitted routes, per-target dispositions, outputs, fault codes and dispatch error boundary.
The product owner must retain that digest independently; a matching receipt can yield only a DENY_ALL continuation for the first incomplete route and refuses incomplete delivered evidence.
Actual retry, downstream target idempotency, blocking work, plugins, model calls and effects remain owned by separate bounded product owners.

nonClaims: Source presence is not production activation.
Repository tests are not independent acceptance.
A deny-all plan or grant request is not an execution capability.
No target-host recovery, operator acceptance, canary, activation, promotion or release is asserted by this file.
